user.title: MAK Grill Setup
user.description: Set up your MAK Pellet Boss WiFi grill. The integration answers the grill at /GrillService/Service, and only accepts the grill's own IP address. Give the grill a DHCP reservation on your router so its address doesn't change.

data_description.grill_host: The grill's IP address on your network, for example 192.168.2.50. Find it in your router's client list.

reconfigure.title: Grill IP address
reconfigure.description: Only POSTs from this address are accepted. Update it if the grill's IP address changed.

error.invalid_ip: Enter an IP address, for example 192.168.2.50

abort.already_configured: The MAK Grill is already set up

no_grill_address.title: MAK Grill: set the grill's IP address
no_grill_address.description: Since version 1.4.0 the integration only accepts telemetry from the grill's own IP address, and none is set, so the grill is being ignored. Open Settings → Devices & Services → MAK Grill → ⋮ → Reconfigure and enter the grill's IP address.
